deferred: generation blocks: 189 of 255 folders carry generation.json, with a block for every program, plenums and attics included (an unconditioned program without loads generates as inactive); the other folders, by class (ADR 0055):

generation blocks of commercial types without a ComStock sampling building type, 36 folders (90-1-2007, 90-1-2013, 90-1-2019: college, courthouse, laboratory, large-data-center-high-ite, large-data-center-low-ite, office, small-data-center-high-ite, small-data-center-low-ite, super-tall-building, tall-building; doe-ref-1980-2004, doe-ref-pre-1980: college, courthouse, office): none, because the generator samples ComStock operating hours for 15 building types (atlas_schedules.programmes.SAMPLING); college, courthouse, laboratory, the data centres, the generic office and the tall and super-tall buildings have none, so their programs have no comstock_hours configuration (ADR 0039, ADR 0055)

generation blocks of IECC commercial apartment buildings, 12 folders (iecc-2006, iecc-2009, iecc-2012, iecc-2015, iecc-2018, iecc-2021: highrise-apartment, midrise-apartment): none, because an apartment is a ResStock unit drawn under the folder's heating and cooling systems (scripts.build_apartment_units, ADR 0047), and the IECC commercial systems are deferred (ADR 0040 item 10)

generation blocks of residential code-prototype dwellings (IECC residential, manufactured housing), 18 folders (doe-final-rule, hud-code: multi-section, single-section; iecc-2006, iecc-2009, iecc-2012, iecc-2015, iecc-2018, iecc-2021, iecc-2024: multifamily, single-family): none, because PNNL and DOE EnergyPlus prototypes with no ResStock dwelling inputs to draw from and no generator family (ADR 0041, ADR 0042; ADR 0046 plan X-3)
